rubrics.text: as of wind issuing from toes
left arm feels as if bound to the side
during heat and redness of the face
as if ice water poured down sciatic
as if blew upon left arm
as if passing down to fingers
as if tied with a string
as from a tightly drawn bandage
grasping involuntarily things taken hold of
feels impelled to make them crack
with feeling as if extremities were going to sleep
the one upon which he was lying
from hip to groin as if everything would be pressed out
pustules spreading over hand to wrist
as if he had intended to take hold of something
deep-seated pain agg. in warm bed
cannot allow one leg to be bent in the morning in bed
in upper arm while resting it on the table
alternately hot and cold as if dead
or hot feet and cold hands
heat shooting to head like electric sparks
at the site of a previous
extending to both arms in chorea
when a stranger enters the room
drawing up leg or standing amel.
sensation of something alive in arms
left arm and foot after fright
seems at night on lying down
when trying to; power of direction impaired
forward over chest during clonic cramp
waving motion of left arm and leg with sighing
after exposure to cold and wet
felt as if not his own legs
